subject: literacy
concept: Reading common vowel teams (ee, ea, oa) and their typical sounds
source_inspiration: adapted from Mississippi Science-of-Reading explicit phonics sequencing principles — original content, not copied text

exercise.concrete: Student joins two vowel letter tiles into one 'vowel team tile' and practices its single sound
exercise.pictorial: Student circles the vowel team in a set of pictured words
exercise.abstract: Student reads words containing vowel teams aloud

misconception_flags: sounds out each vowel in the team separately instead of as one sound

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
